{{- /* Markdown image for the figure shortcode. Returns a string (no escaping). */ -}} {{- $u := urls.Parse (.Get "src") -}} {{- $src := $u.String -}} {{- if not $u.IsAbs -}} {{- $path := strings.TrimPrefix "./" $u.Path -}} {{- with or (.Page.Resources.Get $path) (resources.Get $path) -}} {{- $src = .Permalink -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $alt := or (.Get "alt") (.Get "caption" | plainify) "" -}} {{- $out := printf "![%s](%s)" $alt $src -}} {{- with .Get "caption" }}{{ $out = printf "%s\n\n*%s*" $out (. | plainify) }}{{ end -}} {{- return $out -}}
